topic: An artist discovers someone has tattooed their work
text: Walking through the gallery, the quiet hum of murmured conversations and the occasional clink of a wine glass against another, my eyes caught a peculiar sight. There, on the arm of a stranger, thrumming with the pulse of the crowd, was my art—a piece I had poured countless nights into, now a permanent dance on someone's skin. The ink, under the soft gallery lights, seemed to shimmer, alive in a way it had never been on canvas. The strokes, though translating through the artist's hand, carried the essence, the breath, I had hoped to capture. It was a strange, almost mystical moment, seeing my work reimagined through another's needle, a new layer of story woven into the fabric of the original.
